text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after emerging victorious through 
many races, I was working in the Trainer's 
Room as usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now, as the trainer of the "Number One 
Umamusume" Daiwa Scarlet, I'm in a 
position where I'm even giving lectures.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive pile of documents is stacked 
high on the desk—the deadline is still far 
off, but for future's sake, pulling an 
all-nighter tonight might be...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! That thing!! Where did you put 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You know, that!! The thing we got at the 
shopping district that I gave you to hold—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of what I borrowed from Daiwa 
Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hold onto this for now, will you? I feel 
like I'll be tempted every time I look at 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but absolutely do not use it without 
asking, okay?! I'm the one who won it! Got 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip ticket! Didn't it 
expire this month?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Jeez! What are you dawdling for?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry up and look for the ticket! 
Ugh, honestly! Your desk is completely 
buried in paperwork!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll help you out too! Come on, get ready, 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Off to the hot springs we go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And rushed along by Daiwa Scarlet, I was 
swept up into getting ready for the 
tripâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nnh~... Haaah... That hot water felt so 
good~...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well, yeah... Wait a second.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How was it for you? Did you get to relax? 
Were you able to unwind properly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, I've suddenly been 
brought to a hot spring. Being completely 
bewildered is only natural—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I know I dragged you out here out of 
nowhere, and I do feel bad about that."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Still, you're at fault too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series has finally settled 
down, and I thought I could finally go to 
the hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Because you don't look free at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I get that you're getting twice as 
much work as the 'Trainer who raised the 
Number One Umamusume.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But, you know... Seeing you look more and 
more worn out each day just pissed me off 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why are you wearing yourself out all 
alone? After working this hard alongside 
me all this time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Am I really that unreliable?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then that's great! Let me take good care 
of you too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"It wouldn't hurt to let me pamper you 
once in a while, you know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At that moment, I remembered what she had 
said when she won these hot spring trip 
tickets.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, we're right in the middle 
of an important season. It's still too 
early for either of us to relax and take 
it easy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, I'd like to take 
things super easy... and let them relax to 
the fullest, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list:
I'm going to lean on you and take it easy 
today.

I'm going to lean on you and take it easy 
today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......Hmph. As long as you understand, 
that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, today's all about enjoying the 
hot springs! We threw all our work aside 
to come here, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you leave until you're 
completely satisfied! Heh-heh, make sure 
you relax as much as you can!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And swept along at her pace, I fully 
enjoyed my rare day off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later, it goes without saying 
that we were able to work feeling 
completely refreshed. ...Together, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Daiwa Scarlet...
